snippet.title: Party Rock Anthem - LMFAO - Learn Melody on Guitar - Skill Test - Gibson Lesson App
snippet.description:
Gibson App Guitar Lesson
My performance 
Song - Party Rock Anthem
Band - LMFAO
Melody Skill Test

I started and stopped
Playing guitar
Many times 

But now we are
Living in the golden age
Of guitar lesson apps
And guitar gear

Guitar is lifetime pursuit 
A natural way
To reset your
Brain like meditation 
Therapy 

My video guitar practice diary
Has helped me remember 
Lessons learned especially
Because I explore every app 
Invented 

Make a Youtube 
Guitar Student Vlog

What keeps you motivated
To practice many hours ?

Guitar gear collection?

Please leave comments

You can find me 
On Twitter X
As MiamiChristine 

Thank you Gibson 
Jamie Humphries
💜💜💜💜💜💜💜

See my pitch detection score
For this lesson
In the video

Play this song 
Pass my score
Its a fun challenge 

Using the Gibson app
Available IOS and Android 

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gibson-learn-play-guitar/id1116032929?ppid=fe1d2d9f-e143-49c3-914f-c8c1340efe40

Gibson app 
Guitar lesson
And guitar game
Is Beginner friendly 
And the app has
Intermediate lessons 
For many years to come

You can now 
Join Facebook Group
Gibson App Fan Club
To meet other guitar
Students at your skill level

Gibson App is only 
Available on Mobile 
Devices so… 
I use Irig HD 2
To connect Guitar
To IPAD Pro

Wired Headphones 
Are a must

You can also
Just use iphone
Built in microphone

My husband Jon and I
Are guitar collectors
Honbyist
With over 50 
Guitars 
We lost count
I think we own 70 
Guitars 

Two guitar collectors
Living in the same house
Its really fun

I am not affiliated
With the Gibson app
I’m simply a fan
Of everything guitar 
And i’m living the dream
Retired and can now
Play guitar for many hours
Every day

#partyrockanthem
#learnguitarfast 
#guitarstudentlife
